_meta.description: Industry electricity-intensity benchmarks (kWh per m2 of floor area per year) for Person 4's IR component. No Sri Lanka-specific published benchmark table was found — these are international figures, flagged accordingly. Use for DIRECTIONAL context only ('you use roughly Nx the median for this building type'), not as a compliance or regulatory yardstick.

office.source: General commercial office-building EUI benchmark range, widely cited in building-energy-efficiency literature (e.g. ClevAir energy-benchmarking overview).

retail_hospitality.source: UK Government ND-NEED 2024 dataset (2022 metered use, England & Wales) — official statistics.

factory_industrial.source: UK Government ND-NEED 2024 dataset (2022 metered use, England & Wales) — official statistics.
factory_industrial.notes: Low per-m2 figure reflects large industrial floor areas relative to load, not low total consumption.

warehouse.source: Derived from US EIA CBECS survey figures (~90,000 kWh/year for a ~1,273 m2 warehouse).
